title: 1. [Home](https://uidai.gov.in/hi)
section: Consent management in the Aadhaar app is governed by the Aadhaar Act and other applicable laws. No identity data is shared without the explicit consent of the Aadhaar Number Holder. If data is updated by an Aadhaar Number Holder(ANH), how soon is it reflected in the Aadhaar App? The processing time for mobile number and/or address updates is up to 30 days. Once the update is successfully completed, the revised data is reflected in the Aadhaar app. Will secure QR codes on PVC Aadhaar cards and e-Aadhaar continue to work, or will they be phased out? QR codes on PVC Aadhaar cards and e-Aadhaar will continue to work and can be scanned easily using the Aadhaar App or Aadhaar QR Code scanner for identity verification. Technically, what standard does the Aadhaar QR follow, and can any app read it? The QR-based verifiable presentation follows a UIDAI specification and OPENID4VP, but the reading capability is limited to the Aadhaar App, Aadhaar QR Code scanner only. Does an entity need a specific SDK from UIDAI to generate QR codes, or is there a different approach? No SDK is required. The OVSE must follow the QR generation guidelines issued by UIDAI. A registered OVSE may contact UIDAI for any technical support related to QR generation.  Content Information Published on: 03 Jun 2026 Last Updated: 18 Sep 2026 Owner: AU
